stem.x: Which of the following is an explanation of ERP?

b.x: It is a method or concept by which wholesalers and manufacturers expand their business transactions with retail stores by supporting the business activities of retail stores.
It is a method or concept for performing business transactions with consumers or between companies through the use of electronic networks such as the Internet.
It is a method or concept that aims to drastically increase sales, profit, and customer satisfaction by improving the efficiency and quality of sales through the use of IT in sales activities.
It is a method or concept that aims to improve management efficiency by planning and controlling the management resources of an entire company in an effective and comprehensive manner.
